narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two and three make five, so it is five to the power four.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Five to the power four is only six hundred twenty five.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The twos and threes are multiplied, not added, so the bubble is wrong.
